policy: Optional only. This registry does not request installation or download. The local probe performs no network access.

resources.name: OpenCV Python
resources.purpose: Local image decoding and image-quality/geometry QA utilities.
resources.license_note: OpenCV 4.5.0+ is Apache-2.0; verify release and bundled dependencies.
resources.limitation: Presence does not imply a validated coconut detector or maturity classifier.

resources.name: CVAT Community
resources.purpose: Optional self-hosted annotation and human review.
resources.license_note: Community core MIT; review FFmpeg and third-party asset/dependency licences.
resources.limitation: Manual status only; the probe does not determine whether a CVAT service is installed or running.

resources.name: Open3D
resources.purpose: Optional depth/point-cloud geometry when real or simulated depth data is available.
resources.limitation: Not needed for the current RGB-only workflow.

resources.name: OpenVINO
resources.purpose: Optional CPU-inference comparison after a baseline is measured.
resources.license_note: Apache-2.0 toolkit; model weights have separate terms.
resources.limitation: A performance gain is not assumed; benchmark on target hardware.

resources.name: Tesseract OCR engine
resources.purpose: Only for a future workflow that genuinely needs visible text extraction.
resources.license_note: Apache-2.0 engine; review language data/package details.
resources.limitation: Not useful for maturity detection by itself.

resources.name: smolagents
resources.purpose: Optional local model tool-calling agent; use fixed read-only tools only.
resources.license_note: Apache-2.0 library; model, tool and sandbox terms are separate. Local model path avoids hosted inference fees.
resources.limitation: Do not use unrestricted CodeAgent or treat agent-generated code as a security boundary.

resources.name: LangGraph
resources.purpose: Optional local stateful workflow/orchestration with explicit branches and review checkpoints.
resources.license_note: MIT library; hosted observability/deployment is optional. Keep model provider local to avoid API fees.
resources.limitation: Orchestration does not improve perception accuracy by itself and adds dependencies.

resources.name: PydanticAI
resources.purpose: Optional typed agent interfaces and test/evaluation helpers.
resources.license_note: MIT library; live inference cost depends on provider. Use local provider or test model only.
resources.limitation: Test models validate application logic, not real-world model accuracy.

resources.name: Ollama local model runtime
resources.purpose: Optional local inference for a manually selected and already downloaded model.
resources.license_note: MIT runtime; each model's licence/size is separate; no hosted API is required.
resources.limitation: Presence check does not inspect installed model weights; never pull a model without approval and resource/licence review.

resources.name: llama.cpp local inference CLI
resources.purpose: Alternative local inference runtime for supported GGUF model files.
resources.license_note: MIT runtime; exact models and bundled components have separate terms.
resources.limitation: Build/runtime compatibility and model memory use must be checked; optional alternative to Ollama.
